name: Jump Stop
idea: Drive in, then stop with both feet at once. Balanced and in control, you can look for the open teammate.
why: If you keep running when a defender steps in front of you, you crash into them or travel. A jump stop lands both feet at the same time, so you're balanced, you haven't traveled, and you can still pass or shoot.
tryit: Dribble toward a cone, pick up the ball, and hop so both feet land together, knees bent. Freeze for a second. Then look up and pass to a partner.

frames.say: {1} has the ball at the top. {2} is on the wing and {5} is down low.
{1} beats {X1} and dribbles hard into the lane.
*Jump stop:* {X5} steps in the way, so {1} stops with both feet landing at the same time. Balanced and no crash!
{X5} left {5} to stop {1}, so {1} bounce-passes to {5}.
Layup! A jump stop keeps you in control, so you can find the open teammate.
